comment: Source is not published, and there is no manual: docs/modules/6OP-DX/Manual.md at tag v2.6.13 is a nine-line placeholder saying the manual will be written for a later version. The entry is built from the census parameter names, which are unusually complete here, and from the rendered panel. The parameter names and the module's own SysEx import and export fix the semantics exactly: SixOpDXModule::importSysEx, exportVMEM and exportVCED read and write DX7 VMEM and VCED voice data, so each control is the DX7 voice parameter its name gives, and the lines describe those without quoting any figure, because no range was read. Twenty-nine parameter indices have no widget position at all and are left untagged and unwritten. THE MODULE PRODUCES NO SOUND: the outputs are only ever resized, never written, which matches the README's statement that the PM engine is not yet enabled. IT IS ALSO HIDDEN: the installed plugin.json marks this model "hidden": true, so it does not appear in the module browser. That is the one thing in this plugin's model registration that would keep a model out of the browser, and no other model carries the flag.
